label: Example 1: Mismatched echoes
description: Bird calls are accompanied by echo patterns that appear spatially or acoustically inconsistent with the source material.

label: Example 2: Morphing calls
description: Bird calls shift or transform over time, blurring the boundary between distinct vocal qualities.

label: Example 3: Synthetic jitter
description: Calls contain rapid jittering artefacts that reveal instability in the generated vocal texture.

label: Example 4: Metallic timbre
description: Bird calls take on metallic or unstable timbral qualities that depart from naturalistic vocalisation.

label: Example 5: Warbling backgrounds
description: Background textures become exaggerated, unstable, or overly intense, competing with the foreground bird calls.

label: Example 6: Wind-coloured owl calls
description: Owl-like calls appear to merge with wind-like timbres, producing an ambiguous hybrid texture.

label: Example 7: Chaotic mixed calls
description: Multiple bird calls overlap in ways that produce a dense, chaotic, or ecologically implausible soundscape.

label: Example 8: Wind-to-call morphing
description: Wind-like background textures appear to transform into bird-call material, blurring the distinction between environment and vocalisation.

label: Example 9: Over-layered soundscape
description: Bird calls and background textures are heavily layered, producing an overly dense soundscape with reduced ecological clarity.

label: Example 10: Misidentified Magpie call
description: The generated call is is Magpie-like, but does not match the expected vocal pattern closely.
